name: Puff Hero
tagline: A landing-page hero whose word is in puffy, overinflated 3D letters that lean toward your cursor and jiggle when you touch them.
youSay: /puff-hero A launch page for our single POP STAR, glossy bubblegum-pink letters on lime green
whatYouGet: A poster-like landing page whose hero is your word in overinflated, wildly deformed 3D letters, in a material made for the brand
Letters that lean toward the cursor, pop when you touch them and jiggle through a seamless loop on hover
Three stills and two loops to choose from, cut out frame by frame so the letters float on the page with real transparency
The page around them: brand, copy, type, a background drawn in code and layouts for desktop and phone, as a static site you can host anywhere
goodFit: Launches, drops, singles, events and seasonal campaigns with a short, playful name
Fashion, music, food, toy and homeware brands that want a loud, tactile first screen
notFor: Long phrases (1–3 short lines of 2–6 letters work best)
youBring: The words and what the page is for
Optional: the material, colours, brand name and tone
needs: A Mac to encode the Safari version of the loop
